propositions: Tracked files with local working-tree deletions or modifications cause git merge origin/tickets to abort with 'Your local changes to the following files would be overwritten by merge', stranding local commits and blocking reconverge advancement.

The recovery mechanism must detect this abort class, parse the named paths from git output, and act per working-tree status: restore deletions via git checkout (content already at HEAD), quarantine and restore modifications (preserving local bytes in reconverge-quarantine dir), then retry the merge once.

Worktree deletions staged as tracked changes (D in git status --porcelain) are the real wedge class from interrupted fold compactions; the abort message format and trailer differ between git strategies (ort vs classic).
Any merge failure outside this specific local-changes class keeps existing abort-only behavior (abort, keep local, hint fsck-recover); genuine content conflicts remain unhandled by self-heal.
